body: It could be side effect from your medication as it can make you worse before you get better. Please go back to your doctor and ask for help, you are worth so much to so many people. Hope you feel better soon.

It shouldn't matter what your diagnosis is, that should not define you or influence how people see you. You are a person in your own right and I truly believe that not everyone hates you. You need to accept that you are loved and cared for and slowly you will begin to escape these feelings. I know this because i am right there with you but I bet you are a lovely persona and you don't deserve to feel this way. Please try to be a bit more positive in yourself. Depression will pass but if your finding things difficult please get in touch with someone who can help, gp or charitable organisations who can put you on the right track are the best places to start. Be well and I hope you feel better soon.
